content.short: Pixelverse is a cyberpunk gaming ecosystem featuring real-time PvP battles and 'tap-to-earn' mechanics.
content.description: Pixelverse is a cyberpunk-themed gaming ecosystem that centers around PixelTap, its flagship Telegram-based PvP game. Players engage in real-time battles, tapping to defeat opponents and upgrading their digital 'Pets' to earn rewards. Pixelverse focuses on fast-paced, competitive gameplay and social interaction, leveraging the TON blockchain for secure asset ownership. With its expansion into a broader metaverse and quest-driven activities, Pixelverse provides a multi-faceted gaming experience for both casual and hardcore players.
content.meta: Enter the cyberpunk world of Pixelverse. Real-time PvP and rewards on TON, featured on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
